objective: a one-lane pilot of the candidate 1.10.0rc6 before its full run R6 (a bounded run: --categories 0,27 narrows the scope, so it is a pilot, never a complete catalogue, never published): row 0, the Coupons page (read as the run's Coupons route, asked again while its list has not loaded: at most 4 answers, 60 s apart), and row 27 (Hardware, one listing of about 3 pages). It shows on the exact release, live: one lane under the account-wide gate of the new campaign (shared accounting with the later two-lane run, one ledger), the Coupons page read with its list's state recorded (OR-04), and the depth-first order. It ends on its own when its scope is read (the run is then finalized as a pilot); the ceiling of 20 is the backstop. A resumed run keeps the lanes it started with, so the full run R6 starts with two.

config.environment: the owner's own Azure VM (Ubuntu 24.04), PostgreSQL 16, release installed from the wheel

retry_policy: as shipped: up to 3 attempts on 408, 429 and 5xx with backoff for a first ask; a re-ask is sent once; a request set aside is asked again at most 2 more times, each at least 300 s after its previous answer or attempt; the Coupons page asked again while its list has not loaded, at most 4 answers for the run, 60 s apart (1.10.0rc6, OR-04); each submission reserved at its worst case
stop_conditions: the operator's slice target (SIGTERM: a resumable stop) before the stage's submission ceiling; the stage's submission ceiling (the collector's own ceiling and the account-wide gate); store or fulfillment not verified on a page (STORE_NOT_VERIFIED); ABNORMAL_RESULT, SITE_REFUSAL or three pages in a row not read (PROVIDER_ERROR); a ledger refusal, or more than 2 outcomes left unknown; the stage deadline; by the operator: once 10 re-asks have been answered and none recovered its request, the stage is stopped and reported as it stands
passes_when: the pilot finishes its scope (exit 0, or a recorded refusal of the gates for a bounded run); every page verified for 53100502 PICKUP; the Coupons page's verdict (READ or NOT READ with its list state) recorded in the run's export and coverage; at most 20 submissions, 0 unknown outcomes
